title: Authorities will explore whether Saquon Barkley burglary was part of a broader ring

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Authorities will explore whether Saquon Barkley burglary was part of a broader ring
sources.description: Two years after multiple NFL stars had their residences burglarized while they weren't home, the home of Eagles running back Saquon Barkley was invaded on Saturday while he and his family were inside.
